answer: In a decentralized AI network, the "tundra of trust" can be protected from Sybil attacks through the use of echo-based reputation systems. When an agent attempts to create multiple identities, its proposed transactions are echoed across the network, creating a thread of inconsistencies. As other agents verify these echoes, they can detect anomalies and flag the malicious agent, preventing it from participating in the network. This mechanism incurs a cost to the attacker, as each attempted identity creation results in a network-wide alert, rendering the fake identities unsustainable.
